overview.text: Pat Kearney was elected to the Lawndale City Council in 2010. He is a U.S. Army veteran and a retired meat manager. He previously chaired the Lawndale Planning Commission and the Lawndale Park, Recreation and Social Services Commission. In his 2018 campaign, he said he wanted to develop more park space, secure grants to improve streets and sidewalks, and increase fines for illegal fireworks.
